about.lead: Web and brand designer who makes real estate and hospitality brands look as good online as their buildings do in person.
about.bio:
Years inside a Dubai real estate agency taught me the work that actually sells property: launch brochures, investor presentations, community market reports and the client documents that close deals.

Now based in Sri Lanka, I design websites and brand systems for developers, holiday-home operators and founders — from first concept in Figma to the final responsive page.

contact.intro: Write me a letter about your project. I reply to every one within two days.
